Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced AI Engineer to design and implement intelligent, autonomous systems using agentic AI. This role involves integrating advanced machine learning models with reasoning, planning, and interaction capabilities to solve real-world problems in the banking domain.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop intelligent systems using LLMs and RAG architectures
Implement autonomous decision-making and task execution workflows
Integrate vector databases and agentic libraries (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Autogen)
Apply computer vision and document processing to unstructured data
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI-driven solutions
Mandatory Skills
Python
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
RAG Architecture
Vector Databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone)
Agentic Libraries (LangChain / LangGraph / Autogen)
Computer Vision
Document Processing
Preferred Domain Experience
Banking and Financial Services
